newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 2.8527 per dlr end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 2.8527 per dlr end-96.

text.p: The Polish zloty is seen easing against the dollar by year-end, but the prediction is virtually flat from last month, according to a Reuter poll of the country's 24 largest banks.
By the end of 1996, the zloty is expected to fall to 2.8527 to the dollar Tuesday's fixing of 2.7760, the poll showed.
The 2.8527 rate is a mean average of forecasts that ranged between 2.6900 and 2.8950.
Last month, banks had predicted a fall in the Polish unit to 2.8525 by year-end. Forecasts ranged from 2.7000 to 2.9120. @
The zloty is expected to trade at an average of 2.7736 in September, with a range o forecasts between 2.7300 and 2.8400.
Banks estimated the zloty would fall to an average of 3.0406 to the dollar in September 1997 with a range of forecasts from 2.8500 to 3.1500.
